title: ScenarioScore
description: STEP 4 aggregate per scenario: bundles all MetricScore fan-out outputs for one test case. Produced deterministically by collecting the metric_score.json files of every (test_case_id, metric_code) pair after the LOOP body returns. No LLM call is made to produce this object.

metric_scores.description: All per-metric fan-out results for this test case. Count must equal len(test_case.applicable_metrics).

trace_ref.description: Relative path to the ExecutionTrace file used as evidence source.

fan_out_diagnostics.description: Operational stats; not consumed by scoring logic.
